paragraphs.text: A project lead for DeepSeek Harness: dispatches tasks to member sessions, reviews them at gates, and
keeps a tagged devlog.
# dsh-master
**English** · 中文
**A project lead for DeepSeek Harness.** Open a session in a project folder with the *dsh-master 总管*
preset, and that session becomes the folder's **master**. It breaks your requests into tasks, hands
them to **member sessions**, collects their structured reports, and stops at every **gate** until t
he work has been checked. It runs as a plain DSH plugin bundle. There is no external service and no
cloud component, and its state lives on your own machine.
> Status: early (0.1.x). Developed and used daily on macOS with DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`. DSH 0.2.2 changed
the schedule API and turned off the file-observation guard by default, so 0.2.2 is not supported yet
. The UI, the role prompts and the tool descriptions are in Chinese, and timestamps are shown in Chi
na Standard Time (UTC+8).
## Why
A single DSH session works well for a single task. Once you have several streams of work going in pa
rallel, you become the scheduler: you switch sessions, remember who was doing what, re-read logs to
see whether anything stalled, and keep it all in your head. dsh-master moves that bookkeeping into t
r anything stalled, and keep it all in your head. dsh-master moves that bookkeeping into the plugin:
- **One master per project.** The master talks to you and coordinates. Members do the work, each in

its own context, and report back to the master rather than to you.
- **Gates instead of "trust me, i
t's done".** Heavy tasks get a written task spec with acceptance criteria. A member that reaches a g
ate reports *ready* and stops. The master reviews the products itself, and records a pass or a send-

back.
- **Memory that is actually consulted.** Every change gets a devlog entry with tags. Before a
member touches a file or topic that has history, the plugin pushes the relevant past entries into it

s context.
- **A board you can glance at.** It is a native DSH side panel: what needs you, what is i
n progress, what finished. You can open every task's timeline, products and Q&A.; It also works on a
phone through dsh-pocket.
## Features
| **Project-based masters** | Starting a session with the *dsh-master 总管* preset in a folder registe
rs that folder as a project. Each project has its own master, members, database, task specs, handboo
ks and devlog. The master's preset has no write/edit tools: it dispatches and reviews, and leaves th

e editing to members. |
| **Structured dispatch & reports** | `master_dispatch`, `master_send`, `mas
ter_spawn` and `master_close` handle the master's side; `master_report` (progress / waiting / blocke
d / failed / ready / done) handles the member's. Messages go straight to the target agent under the
plugin's own message source. They never pose as user messages. They are de-duplicated and retried wi

th backoff, and pending deliveries survive a restart. |
| **Gates & reviews** | Heavy tasks need a t
ask spec first (`task_spec_write`): goal, deliverables, acceptance criteria, red lines, expected dur
ation. Gates appear on the board, and `master_review` records each pass or send-back on the timeline

. |
| **Ask the user, on the board** | Members cannot interrupt you. When a decision is yours, the m
aster asks through `master_ask_user`. The question shows up as a "needs you" card with clickable opt

ions, and your answer is relayed back. |
| **Devlog memory** | `devlog_add` / `devlog_recall` / `dec
ision_add` / `memory_write` keep a tagged development log, a decision log and memories per project.
Recall matches on tags (weighted by IDF), and relevant entries are pushed automatically before a ste

p touches related files or topics. |
| **Guards** | Agents cannot write the plugin's state directly,
only through its tools. Members cannot `git add/commit/push` in a shared project root; the master c
ommits after review. When dispatching, the master can claim files and directories for a task; a memb
er writing into another task's claim is blocked. Only the master can read the instance log directory

nto another task's claim is blocked. Only the master can read the instance log directory. |

## Requirements
- DeepSeek Harness **`dsh web`**, version `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.2.2-0`, i.e. the 0.2.1 line (declared in
`engines.dsh`; DSH refuses to install or load it outside this range, including 0.2.2 pre-releases).

- Node.js **>= 22.19** (the plugin uses the built-in `node:sqlite`).
- macOS is the only platform te

>= 22.19** (the plugin uses the built-in `node:sqlite`).
- macOS is the only platform tested so far.
## Install
> **Where to install.** All profiles under one `DSH_HOME` share the session list, schedules and mode
l credentials. If you install into your everyday profile, the master and member sessions appear next
to your everyday sessions (see What it changes). To keep them apart, run a separate instance with i
ts own `DSH_HOME` (option B).

## Quick start
1. Click **New session**, pick your project folder, and choose the **dsh-master 总管** agent preset. S

end it a first message: the folder is now a project, and this session is its master.
[该节后续省略]
## What it changes in your DSH
Before installing, you should know exactly what the plugin touches:
- **Two agent presets** appear in the preset list: *dsh-master 总管* (master) and *dsh-master 执行会话* (m

ember, used by the plugin itself).
- **Sessions:** masters and members are ordinary DSH sessions, so
they show up in the sidebar. Sessions that do not belong to a project get no extra tools, prompts o

r reminders.
- **Guard rules for every session in the profile:** only two rules apply to sessions ou
tside a project. They cannot read `secretPaths`, and they cannot write the plugin's state directorie
s (`$DSH_HOME/dsh-master`, `<project>/.dsh-master/` except `out/`). All other rules apply only to ma

sters and members.
- **Schedules:** one *dsh-master 定时巡检保底* entry per project master in your Automat

ions list.
- **Files:** the plugin's state directory and a `.dsh-master/` folder in each project roo
t (task specs, handbooks, devlog, products). Nothing outside these places is touched.
